name: Roster
consensus_round: resolve_challenge: binds ok, verdict and meets_criteria

verified_on_chain.entry_1_path: unchallenged, listed by finalise_entry after the window closed
verified_on_chain.exit_path: both entries delisted by the applicant, stakes returned

withdrawal_path.result: a pending application taken back by its own applicant is WITHDRAWN, get_list_integrity still agrees, and nothing is counted as removed

superseded_deployments.reason: a listed entry returned its deposit while settlement still assumed it was held
meets_criteria was coerced with bool(), so the string "false" would have become KEEP, and a failed round fell back to STRIKE
a successful removal challenge left the entry counted as listed, so get_listed and get_list disagreed about the same list

withdraw_application recorded a voluntary withdrawal as REMOVED, which is the status a listing gets when a challenger bonds against it and wins. REMOVED is also a population the list keeps a figure for and nothing incremented it, so one withdrawal made get_list_integrity report that the stored counters disagreed with the entries

verdicts.KEEP: the entry meets the criteria, the challenger's bond goes to the applicant less the curation fee
verdicts.STRIKE: it does not, the applicant's deposit goes to the challenger less the curation fee
verdicts.UNRESOLVED: the round produced no usable finding, the bond goes back whole, the deposit stays staked, the entry returns to its prior status, no fee and no standing change

result_parser_rules: meets_criteria must be a JSON boolean literal, since bool("false") is True in Python
the boolean check precedes any numeric reading, since isinstance(True, int) is also True
a refusal is returned as data, never raised, because a raise inside the nondeterministic block cannot be caught by the deterministic frame
a failure of the consensus machinery resolves to UNRESOLVED rather than deciding the case against the applicant

reverified_on_chain.list: Maintained Open Source Libraries, 1 GEN deposit, 180 second window, 500 bps fee

challenge_0.note: the validator held the fetched page itself to the criteria and would not infer maintenance it could not see

reverified_on_chain.entry_1_path: unchallenged, listed by finalise_entry after the window closed, then delisted by the applicant

counter_rules: finalise_entry and a won admission challenge count an entry as listed, on the list and on the applicant record
a lost removal challenge uncounts it on both and counts it as removed
get_list_integrity walks the entries and reports whether the stored counters agree, so the invariant is checkable from outside

removal_counters_proof.verdict: STRIKE, the validator citing that the page was an encyclopedia article about the category rather than a project page

entry_statuses.LISTED: on the list, deposit staked for as long as it sits there
entry_statuses.REJECTED: an admission challenge was won against it
entry_statuses.REMOVED: a removal challenge was won against it, and it is uncounted as listed
entry_statuses.WITHDRAWN: the applicant took it back themselves, whether pending or listed, and the deposit was returned
